# Belt-and-suspenders Disallow for /wiki/* — the path is already
# Caddy-gated to tailnet (it 404s for public clients), but if a search
# engine somehow encountered a /wiki/ URL (e.g. via leaked link), this
# tells them not to index. Defense in depth.

User-agent: *
Disallow: /wiki/

# Allow everything else — public docs are meant to be indexed.
Allow: /
